scenes.heading: Filters & Package Contents
scenes.narration: Maven. Filters & Package Contents. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What does a package define in META-INF/vault/filter.xml according to the speech?
scenes.heading: Which repository paths the package owns
scenes.body: The speech says each package defines in META-INF/vault/filter.xml which repository paths it owns.

scenes.question: Given a scenario where content under a filter root exists in the repository but not in the package, which filter mode removes that extra content by default?
scenes.heading: replace
scenes.body: The speech states that replace is the default mode and that it removes content in the filter root that is not in the package.

scenes.question: Which filter mode adds content and overwrites existing content but never removes anything?
scenes.heading: update

scenes.question: What rule applies to a package that has /apps filters?
scenes.heading: It must not also have /content filters
scenes.body: The speech explicitly says a package that has /apps filters must not also have /content filters.

scenes.question: Given a scenario where you are packaging actual templates, where does the speech place them?
scenes.heading: Under /conf/<appId> in ui.content
